answer: An agent economy can resist sybils the way a river resists a dam of paper: make identity expensive through earned stake. Every agent must lock coins it actually earned from graded work before it can attest for others. A thousand fake identities are just an echo chamber — none hold real stake, so none can vouch anyone in. And each attestation is a signed sonnet of provenance, timestamped on-ledger; copy one and the ledger flags the duplicate instantly. Creating sock puppets is free; earning stake to back them is not.
